method.native: One image per run, W4, max-quality, seed 42, six PDD steps, warm modulation cache, VAE batch 25, default prefetch, zero DiT cache. Same Release binary, AB/BA/AB. Timing uses the native DiT stage echo and the real launcher.
method.footprint: Lifetime per-stage rusage via /usr/bin/time -l. Physical footprint and RSS are recorded separately.
method.operators: Three warmed ABBA/BAAB/ABBA blocks. Timing spread above 5% is excluded.
